features.headerText: Eight integrated tools, so you don't need loose spreadsheets or a separate app for every task.

items.text: No more tasks lost in chat screenshots. Drag and drop between lists and see the team's real progress.

items.title: Table

items.title: Calendar
items.text: Deadlines and start dates in a monthly view, so nothing slips by unnoticed.

items.title: Timeline
items.text: The whole project schedule at a glance, period by period.

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: Metrics and indicators ready to show progress without building a single spreadsheet.

items.title: Map
items.text: Tasks with addresses plotted on an interactive map. Great for field teams.

items.title: Eisenhower Matrix
items.text: Prioritize by urgency and importance and stop working only on what shouts loudest.

items.title: Meeting minutes
items.text: Agenda, decisions and action items recorded and followed up on later.

secondary.title: User and role management

privacy.headerText: How Cantiere collects, uses, stores and protects your team's data.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what is needed to operate the platform. The data comes from what you provide when creating an account and from the content you produce while using it.
bullets: Account data: name, email, password and the company name given at registration.
Content you create: boards, lists, cards, descriptions, due dates, checklists, labels, assignees, meeting minutes and attached files.
Addresses: only when you add an address to a card to show it on the Map.
Session data: the information needed to keep you securely signed in.

sections.title: 2. How we use information
paragraphs: We use the data solely to provide and maintain the service. We do not sell your data, do not use it for advertising and do not pass it to third parties for marketing.
bullets: Authenticate your access and keep your session active.
Display and sync board content among the members of your company.
Convert addresses into coordinates for display on the Map.
Send important operational notices about the service.
Investigate and prevent misuse, fraud and security incidents.

sections.title: 3. How we disclose information
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent personal data. Disclosure happens only in the situations below.
bullets: With other users in your company: content on shared boards is visible to the other members. Private boards are visible only to the person who created them.
With the OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) geocoding service: when you search for an address, only the address text is sent to obtain the coordinates. No account data is transmitted.
For legal reasons: when required by law, court order or a competent authority.

sections.title: 4. How we store and secure information
paragraphs: Each company's data is kept in an isolated database, separate from the other companies on the platform.
bullets: Passwords are never stored in plain text: we keep only a cryptographic hash.
Every API route requires authentication, and each request is validated against the company and the user's permissions.
The session uses an httpOnly cookie, inaccessible to page scripts.
In production, all traffic uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS).
Write requests have their origin verified, which blocks actions forged by third-party sites.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep data while the account is active and for the period needed to meet legal obligations.
When an administrator deletes a user, the account is removed, their private boards are deleted and references to them on cards are unlinked.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We do not use advertising cookies or cross-site tracking.
bullets: Session cookie: holds the token that keeps you signed in, valid for 7 days.
Browser local storage: holds only your theme and language preferences.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Under applicable data protection law, you may at any time:
bullets: Confirm that processing exists and access your data.
Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data, directly in your profile.
Request deletion of the account and associated data.
Export your board content in JSON format, from within the platform.
Withdraw consent and object to processing you consider improper.

sections.title: 8. Our policy towards children
paragraphs: Cantiere is a corporate tool intended for professional use. We do not direct the service to anyone under 18 and do not knowingly collect children's data. Accounts identified in those conditions will be removed.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the service or in the law. The last-updated date at the top of this page always indicates the current version. Material changes will be communicated through the registered contact channels.

sections.title: 10. How to contact us
paragraphs: For questions about this policy or about how your data is handled, contact the data protection officer:
bullets: Email: [FILL IN: contact email]
Legal entity: [FILL IN: registered company name]
Tax ID: [FILL IN: tax identification number]
Address: [FILL IN: full address]
